objective: Define a conservative shape/phase sweep for the existing persistent resident state ABI path before changing runtime ABI or returning to a different workload family.

source_context.summary: Historical resident overhead breakdown and runtime-boundary review selected this sweep. Those local candidate records are summarized by the tracked roadmap and selection state, not required as public-pack source files.

existing_workflow.workflow_gap: The existing public CLI measures one shape/phase case at a time and writes the fixed repeat-median summary path, so the next implementation gate must add a reproducible sweep workflow with distinct per-case reports and an aggregate summary.

planned_matrix.reason: shorter phase count for the existing baseline shape
existing baseline shape and phase count, retained as the anchor
longer per-phase repeated-step span with the same state count
larger state-parallel count with the existing per-phase step count

required_metrics: median hybrid wall ms per final state-step
median GPU kernel total ms per final state-step
state authority and phase shape list

required_workflow_gate.name: implement_persistent_resident_state_abi_shape_phase_sweep_workflow_gate
must_implement: a public dry-run path for the fixed matrix
distinct per-case report paths so matrix cases do not overwrite each other
an aggregate generated summary report under reports/
contract tests for command expansion, report naming, and source-of-truth references
documentation mention for the new public workflow
